## Summary of Changes
Provide a brief description of the motivation and context behind these changes.

## Affected Domain / Team
- [ ] Core Incident Engine & Normalization Pipeline
- [ ] DevOps & Infrastructure
- [ ] Salesforce Monitoring & Integrations
- [ ] Web Engineering & Synthetic Monitoring
- [ ] Data & Analytics / Power BI
- [ ] Security & RBAC / Organizations

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or lint errors.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit and integration tests pass locally with my changes (`mvn test` and `npm test`).
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules.
